## About
Modern Auto Technology was founded by Leon Berberian, who was known for honest, quality auto repair. His son John Berberian now owns the shop and carries on that legacy, working alongside a team that believes in continuing education.
We specialize in foreign and exotic cars and restore vintage cars, and we work on domestic cars too. Whether it's a repair after an accident or something simple, we use quality diagnostic tools and inspect every car so we fix what it actually needs.
You'll find us on Washington Blvd in Pasadena, serving drivers across the San Gabriel Valley.

## Services
- Engine performance and advanced diagnostics: Tracking down hard to find problems with quality diagnostic tools and a careful inspection.
- Transmission repair and overhaul: Repair and overhaul work on transmissions.
- Brake repair and ABS diagnostics: Brake repair and ABS brake system diagnostics.
- A/C and heating repair: Getting your heat and air conditioning working again.
- Body and paint repair: Scrapes, dings and accident repair handled by ASE certified body and paint work.
- Foreign, exotic and vintage cars: Our specialty. We also restore vintage cars to their former glory.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on foreign cars?
A: No. We specialize in foreign and exotic cars, but we also work on domestic cars.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 2243 E Washington Blvd, Pasadena, CA 91104.
